teaser: "Whose idea was this, anyway?" someone asks, and the answer is yours, again. Life path 1 is the number of the self-starter, and ENFP is the type that falls in love with a new idea before breakfast. Crossed together, the question is not whether leading comes naturally — it does, almost by reflex — but whether staying with the thing you started lasts long enough to call it yours. The pull toward the next bright notion is real. So is the pull to be first through the door.
excerpt: Three times the ferry has pulled out of the dock while you were still mid-sentence on the phone, explaining the new plan you've made for a life neither of you has fully agreed to yet.
